writer on missions

Second daughter of Colin Mackenzie (d. 1835),of Portmore,and Elizabeth (d. 1852), daughter of Sir William Forbes of Pitsligo 6th Bt., she edited The Net Cast in Many Waters: Sketches from the Lives of Missionaries; and cared for her invalid nephew George Ralph Dundas (1844-1869). [F. Awdry, An Elder Sister; ODNB]
